purpose: identical packet handed to A4/A5/A6 before any proposal is written; outcome-blind: no per-arm result files exist anywhere in the tree (Phase P published data facts only)
mission: On a survivorship-aware single-name panel (410 SEC filers x EODHD daily prices), do PIT-fundamentals-conditioned mechanisms from the frozen 154-clock set produce incremental after-cost information beyond SPY/sector beta?

binding_rules.count: exactly two proposals per lane, six total, outcome-blind
binding_rules.fundamentals_quota: at least 3 of 6 proposals must condition on the multi-vintage SEC PIT panel via the frozen 154 clocks; lanes A4+A5 are the fundamentals axes (4 proposals), lane A6 is the single non-fundamentals axis (2 proposals) - satisfies quota and wave diversity binding
binding_rules.wave_diversity: each lane owns ONE distinct axis assigned by A1; a proposal must not duplicate another lane's axis
binding_rules.clock_citation: a proposal may cite only clocks whose proposed_status == FUNDED_CANDIDATE in research/control/stocks_free_v6_run/p0a_fundable_clocks.json (sha256 ff328a98..., 154 clocks); any other clock is UNFUNDED and the proposal INELIGIBLE
binding_rules.forbidden: stocks_free_v8_run/forbidden_family_inventory.json (incl. the eight rejected families, rescue variants, vol-level shadow region measured-closed rho 0.319>0.20, and the blocked-channel section) is binding; each proposal carries a forbidden_inventory_screen section
binding_rules.control_lesson: L7: a control rank-identical to its anchor cannot identify anything; proposals must state the control's intended correlation profile and why it differs from the anchor's mechanism
binding_rules.universe_eligibility: filer in frozen 410 panel + servable in p2_coverage_first.json + ADV63 >= 2_000_000 USD (band C or better) + RAW price >= 1.00 at decision; folds S0_FOLD_1/2/3 per p3_invariants_freeze.json
binding_rules.costs: liquidity-band model per p3_invariants_freeze.json v8_additions: base 10/15/25 bps per side (bands A/B/C), stress = 2x base band cost, applied to BOOKED PnL; proposals declare base AND stress costs for their expected turnover
binding_rules.data_availability: prices: EODHD daily bars readable at session close + 1 session; fundamentals: multi-vintage as-of semantics (latest filed vintage with avail < gate(t)), never latest-in-store

authorized_data.prices: EODHD All World daily OHLCV RAW primary + adjusted cross-check; 409 files sha256-pinned in stocks_free_v8_run/p0a_eodhd_price_manifest.json; staged .staging_prices_v8/eod
authorized_data.pit_conditioning: multi-vintage SEC panel 3,817,158 records / 410 filers sha256 1cb115d3... staged .staging_sec_v8/multivintage_panel.jsonl; canonical bridge research/assets/stocks/pit_conditioning.py untouched
authorized_data.census_fields: 38 census fields per research/control/stocks_free_v6_run/p0a_coverage_census.json (per-field coverage + age-bounded variants)

attestation_template: I wrote these proposals without access to any V8 scored outcome, any per-arm artifact, or any parameter search over returns; my only inputs were this packet and the committed evidence files it cites.
output_contract: each lane returns exactly two complete proposal JSON objects (all required_sections populated); A1 writes them to research/control/stocks_free_v8_run/proposals/, hashes and commits them
